title: The Dead World
description: A mod that adds dead and dried-out forest in your world, to add some variation.
body:
💀 The Dead World 💀

Step into a version of Minecraft where life has withered away and the land itself feels cursed. The Dead World adds sprawling dried-out forests and eerie wastelands that make your adventures feel darker, tougher, and way more atmospheric.

🔥 Key Features:

Withered Forests: Leafless trees claw at the sky, their bark gray and lifeless. Perfect for gathering resources—or setting up a haunted hideout.

Dried Earth: Grass and rivers fade into dust, coarse dirt, and cracked terrain that looks like it hasn’t seen rain in centuries.

Creepy Atmosphere: Silence hangs heavy. No birds, no buzzing bees—just you, the wind, and the creak of old wood.

Survival Twist: The wood, plants, and soil here can still be used, but everything feels decayed and strange, like a world past its prime.

✨ Why Play This Mod?
Because sometimes, the world doesn’t need to be lush and green. The Dead World is for survivors who want a harsher challenge, builders who love eerie scenery, and explorers searching for rare, unsettling lands.
